Локальная модель-помощник для Claude Cod: Local helper model for Claude Code and other IDEs
Offload устанавливает llama.cpp и локаль: Offload installs llama.cpp and a local coding model, runs llama-server on your computer and connects to IDEs (Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and others) as an MCP server. Everything is stored in your user profile; no administrator rights are needed.
Облачная модель поручает Offload рутинны: The cloud model delegates routine subtasks to Offload: reading and analyzing files, condensing a long build log, a first-pass diff review, writing a commit message, creating a file from a description or making a mechanical edit. The local model reads the files and writes the code, and only a short result reaches the cloud model's context — so fewer cloud tokens are spent.
Чтобы начать, перезапустите Claude Code: To get started, restart Claude Code after connecting and ask: “use offload to …”.
